correctness.rationale: For the exact parameter R=(1:2:3:4), the projective Jacobian is exhausted exactly: in w=1 its lexicographic elimination polynomial is (2z+3)(4z-3)^4(8z+3)/4096 and the remaining equations recover exactly the five prescribed singular points, while the charts at w=0 are empty. At R the local terms of degree below three vanish and the cubic tangent cone has no projective critical point, so it is smooth and the germ is an ordinary triple point. At the four additional points the affine Hessian determinants are 10762227/2, -530181288, 4921675101/2, and -121002336, hence all are A1 nodes. Smoothness on the blow-up along the moving triple-point section, Hessian nondegeneracy at the node sections, and properness of the residual relative singular locus give a nonempty Zariski-open parameter set with exactly this five-point basket. The bundled verifier reproduces all exact calculations.

value.rationale: The visible singularities are central geometric features of the first unexpected surface in projective three-space, yet the defining paper labels the four additional points only by multiplicity. The exact generic basket upgrades that information to resolution-theoretic data: one ordinary triple point resolved by one blow-up with a smooth elliptic exceptional curve of self-intersection -3, four rational double points of type A1, and no hidden generic singularities. This is a structural statement about the full named family; the rational specialization is only a certificate that the relevant open conditions are nonempty.
